svg.aria-label: I lost my job, and this is what I built at home. My wife says it doesn't make money — driving ride-share or delivering food would pay better. I can't win the argument, so please give me a Star ★ — I just want to show her it means something.

g.text: I lost my job, and this is what I built at home. My wife says it doesn't make money —
driving ride-share or delivering food would pay better. I can't win the argument,
so please give me a Star ★ — I just want to show her it means something.
